title: Exec hire brief + risk scan (1p)
content:
Purpose and audience: Quick 1-page briefing for the recruiting committee and hiring execs to summarize the hire ask, the high-level scorecard, and a short risk scan before offer. Use this for decision discussion and for handing off to onboarding once the offer is accepted.

Role snapshot
- Title: Senior Director, Inference Platform (executive IC/people-leader hybrid)
- Hiring manager: Samir Gupta (vp-serving-runtime)
- Target start: 2025-05 (flex)
- Headcount bucket: FY25 M4 approved (see JIRA HIRE-2029)
- Business impact: Lead roadmap to move Dedicated/Private from pilot to repeatable enterprise revenue; owns SLOs for latency/cost unit economics and customer upgrade paths.

Why now (1-2 bullets)
- Uptick in inbound enterprise deals requesting Private + Dedicated architecture guarantees; need an experienced leader to operationalize SLA delivery and partner with sales/solutions.
- Current team stretched across platform and infra pilots; this role centralizes release-to-ops accountability and drives model-serving economics playbook.

Top-level scorecard (5 lenses, keep short)
1) Domain expertise (25%): Prior production inference/platform leadership; tangible experience running GPU-backed inference or similar systems.
2) Delivery & ops (25%): Track record of shipping SLO-backed services, incident runbooks, and operationalizing rollouts for customers.
3) People & org (20%): Can recruit/mentor managers, create career ladders for infra engineers, and run cross-functional alignment rituals.
4) Strategic judgment (20%): Sets product vs infra tradeoffs, cost/latency balance, vendor ownership decisions.
5) Communication & stakeholder mgmt (10%): Negotiates with sales/CS and articulates tradeoffs to execs and customers.

Interview loop (recommended, minimal):
- Recruiter screen (30m): culture fit, compensation alignment, logistics (recruiting lead)
- Hiring manager (60m): past work, architecture, SLO ownership examples
- Systems leadership panel (2x45m): one infra/serving technical peer + one platform/ops peer; focus on incident leadership, runbooks, capacity planning
- Org/People round (45m): hiring/mentorship approach, org design, career ladders
- Exec alignment (30m): GTM impact, customer escalations, pricing implications
- Debrief + bar-raiser (async): standardized rubric scoring in shared spreadsheet (link above)

Rubric (simplified for quick use)
- Rate each dimension 1-5; comment required for any 1 or 2.
- Hiring threshold: average >= 3.6 and no dimension < 3.
- Fast-fail trigger: clear mismatch on SLO/incident ownership or lack of prior operating at company scale.

Risk scan (quick, for committee)
- Ramp time: 12–16 weeks to be fully operational across Dedicated & Private. Plan: shadow existing SRE/product lead for 6 weeks, then own one customer rollout by week 12.
- Tech gaps: Candidate may lack deep GPU-inference kernel experience (risk mitigated by senior infra peers + hiring of a senior engineer).
- Org friction: Role sits between product and infra; risk of ambiguous scope. Mitigation: add 30-day charter doc and quarterly alignment ritual (owner: hiring manager).
- Compensation & market: Senior exec-level market is tight; expect counteroffers. Recruiter note: propose 2:1 interview-to-offer cadence to reduce leak.
- Compliance: If candidate requires relocation or foreign employment contract, involve Legal early (linked artifact: confluence:Legal/Exec-Comp-Checklist).

Immediate 72h handoff checklist (if offer accepted)
- People Ops: confirm start date, comp letter finalized, background check initiated (owner: recruiter)
- IT/Security: provision temporary read-only access to architecture docs and SSO invite (owner: IT)
- Manager: schedule 1st-week calendar (intro with product, infra, SRE, GTM)
- Onboarding packet: send role charter + 90-day goals + list of customers in-flight (owner: manager)

30/60/90 onboarding micro-plan (high level)
- 0-30d: Observe + learn. Deliverable: 1-pg current-state summary of Dedicated & Private (risks, customers, backlog).
- 31-60d: Lead. Deliverable: own one customer upgrade plan and run a postmortem for a recent incident.
- 61-90d: Optimize and hire. Deliverable: propose organizational adjustments and 90-day hiring priorities.

Decision & sign-off
- Recommended decision owner: VP, Serving Runtime (Samir Gupta)
- Budget owner: Head of Platform Finance (cc: finance slack)
- Deadline for decision: 2025-03-03 (to preserve candidate availability)

Open questions for committee (to resolve this week)
- Final scope: level of direct reports (2 vs 4 managers)?
- Travel expectation: domestic only or global customer travel required?
- Relocation support: yes/no and cap amount.

Notes and references
- Quick links: confluence:HR/Executive-hires-Playbook | JIRA HIRE-2029 | slack:#hire-ops | hiring rubric spreadsheet (internal)
- Suggested doc to produce post-hire: 30d charter + first-90-day success metrics (owner: new hire + manager)

Version history / context
- Drafted by Asha Patel 2025-02-10; updated after panel calibration 2025-02-15 (Jordan Lee, Marina Kovács)
